summary: Zhibao Technology, a Shanghai-based insurance broker listed on Nasdaq, filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its Extraordinary General Meeting held September 29, 2026, equivalents to a US special meeting. Holders of 418,109,184 of 449,264,625 Class A shares voting as of the September 1 record date approved four proposals: increasing authorized capital to 2.0 billion shares, adopting amended articles granting veto rights to Botao Ma, a contingent 1-for-50 share consolidation triggered if the bid price falls below US$0.12, and conforming articles. No special situation, deal terms, or advisor was disclosed.
